cards.name: Lake Salda

access.note: Straight-line distances from Wikidata coordinates; road distances are longer.

season.rule: Months with a mean temperature of 10 °C or more, minimum above 0 °C, and precipitation at or below the yearly mean (NASA POWER climatology).

tests.test: Rehearse coring and sample caching in carbonate rock, as Perseverance does at Jezero's margin.
tests.based_on: Hydromagnesite shoreline, a carbonate similar to those detected at Jezero

tests.test: Test close-range instruments (X-ray and Raman spectrometers, microscopic imagers) on layered structures that could hold biosignatures.
Practise rover driving and terrain mapping on soft shoreline deposits and old lake terraces, then compare with Jezero's delta and margin.
tests.based_on: A lake basin, like Jezero's former lake

cards.tests_note: Suggested by AI from the site's published evidence using fixed rules; for the team to review.
cards.not_analog_for: Not analog for: Mars's air pressure (under 1% of Earth's), cold, dryness or radiation. Equipment tests here cover geology, chemistry and handling, not the Martian environment.

gaps.why: no value at Jezero to compare with
